import HartshorneLib.Chapter4TangentAlgebra
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectiveStalkCoordinates

/-!
# Linear tangent producers from polynomial-fraction coordinates

This is the algebraic producer used by projective pullback tangent arguments.
The geometric chart-to-polynomial bridge is kept as an explicit hypothesis.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Hartshorne

open MvPolynomial IsLocalRing

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

universe u

theorem exists_irreducible_linear_combination_of_polynomial_fractions
    {k R J : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Fintype J]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] [Algebra k R]
    (c : J → R) (i : J) (hi : c i = 1)
    (hres : Function.Surjective ((residue R).comp (algebraMap k R)))
    (hfrac : ∀ r : R, ∃ p q : MvPolynomial J k,
      IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap k R) c q) ∧
        r * MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap k R) c q =
          MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap k R) c p) :
    ∃ a : J → k,
      Irreducible (∑ j, algebraMap k R (a j) * c j) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, a, ha⟩ := exists_irreducible_sub_algebraMap_of_polynomial_fractions
    c hres hfrac
  have hsingle (i : J) (b : k) :
      (∑ l, algebraMap k R (if l = i then b else 0) * c l) =
        algebraMap k R b * c i := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp
    · intro l _ hli
      simp [hli]
    · simp
  let a' : J → k := fun l =>
    (if l = j then 1 else 0) - (if l = i then a else 0)
  refine ⟨a', ?_⟩
  have hsum :
      (∑ l, algebraMap k R (a' l) * c l) =
        (∑ l, algebraMap k R (if l = j then 1 else 0) * c l) -
          ∑ l, algebraMap k R (if l = i then a else 0) * c l := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l hl
    simp only [a', map_sub]
    ring
  rw [hsum, hsingle, hsingle, map_one, one_mul, hi]
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using ha

namespace ProjectivePullback

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {n : ℕ}
  {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- A surjective projective stalk map on a smooth curve produces a linear form
whose germ is irreducible in the pulled-back chart. The coefficients depend on
the chosen chart and the finite-combination witness. -/
theorem exists_irreducible_pulledLinearForm_of_stalkMap_surjective
    (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (x : NonGenericPoint X) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : f x.1 ∈ ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) i)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x.1).hom) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → k,
      Irreducible ((X.left.presheaf.germ
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) x.1 hi).hom
        (∑ j, X.left.overAlgebraMap k (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i)
            (c j) *
          (f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i)
            (f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i) le_rfl).hom
            (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j))) := by
  classical
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) i
  let R := X.left.presheaf.stalk x.1
  let g := (X.left.presheaf.germ U x.1 hi).hom
  let φ := g.comp (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
  letI : Algebra k R := φ.toAlgebra
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom x.2
  let coords : Fin (n + 1) → R := fun j =>
    g ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
      (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j))
  have hcoord_i : coords i = 1 := by
    change g ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
      (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i i)) = 1
    rw [ProjectiveTwist.coordinate_self]
    have happ := map_one (f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
    calc
      g ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom 1) = g 1 :=
        congrArg g happ
      _ = 1 := map_one g
  have hmid : (X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x.1 trivial).hom.comp
      (X.left.overAlgebraMap k ⊤) = φ := by
    rw [show X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x.1 trivial =
        X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op ≫
          X.left.presheaf.germ U x.1 hi from
        (X.left.presheaf.germ_res (homOfLE le_top) x.1 hi).symm,
      CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_assoc,
      X.left.overAlgebraMap_naturality k (homOfLE le_top).op]
  have hres : Function.Surjective ((residue R).comp (algebraMap k R)) := by
    letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom)
    letI : Smooth (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
      SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 _
    letI : Module k (X.left.residueField x.1) :=
      X.left.residueFieldOverModule k x.1
    letI := Scheme.residueDeg_finite (K := k) x.2
    letI : Algebra k (X.left.residueField x.1) :=
      (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k x.1).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra.IsIntegral k (X.left.residueField x.1) :=
      Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite k _
    have hh : Function.Surjective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k x.1) :=
      IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral.surjective
    rw [Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap, hmid] at hh
    exact hh
  have hfrac : ∀ z : R, ∃ p q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k,
      IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap k R) coords q) ∧
        z * MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap k R) coords q =
          MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (algebraMap k R) coords p := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨p, q, hq, hpq⟩ :=
      exists_polynomial_stalk_fraction_of_surjective f hf x.1 i hi hsurj z
    exact ⟨p, q, hq, hpq⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_irreducible_linear_combination_of_polynomial_fractions
    coords i hcoord_i hres hfrac
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  change Irreducible (∑ j, φ (c j) * coords j) at hc
  change Irreducible (g (∑ j, X.left.overAlgebraMap k U (c j) *
    (f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
      (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j)))
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul]
  exact hc

end ProjectivePullback

end

end Hartshorne
